```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)

# https://www.pmassicotte.com/posts/2022-08-15-removing-whitespace-around-figures-quarto/
knitr::knit_hooks$set(crop = knitr::hook_pdfcrop)
```


```{r}
#| echo: false

## cite https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/r-language/how-to-read-many-files-in-r-with-loop/
##https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-basics.html

img_filenames = list.files(path = "images", pattern = "\\.csv$")
images = list()
for (file in img_filenames) {
  filepath <- paste0("images/", file)
  # read in image matrix
  img_mx <- read.csv(filepath) |> data.matrix()
  images[[file]] <- img_mx
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
get_plot_obj <- function(mat, label = ""){
  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(mat)) 
  plot_obj <- ggplot(df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq))+
    ggtitle(label)+
    geom_tile(show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "black", high = "white") +
    coord_equal()+
    theme_void()
  return(plot_obj)
}
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| layout-ncol: 2

process_img_kaprrox <- function(X, k_list){
  pca <- prcomp(X,  center=FALSE, scale.=FALSE)
  original <- get_plot_obj(X)
  approx_imgs <- list(original)
  error_list <- c()
  #print("starting interation over k")
  for (k in k_list) {
    new_mx <- (pca$x[,1:k] # PC scores for k columns
            %*% t(pca$rotation[,1:k])) # Transpose ofirst k cols of the matrix of variable loadings (i.e., a matrix whose columns contain the eigenvectors
    label <- paste0("K = ", k)
    plot_obj <- get_plot_obj(new_mx)
    
    approx_imgs[[length(approx_imgs)+1]] <- plot_obj
    error <- norm((X-new_mx), type = "F")
    error_list <- c(error_list, error)
  }
  df_error <- tibble(
    k = k_list,
    error = error_list)
  error_plot <- df_error |> 
    ggplot(aes(k, error))+
    geom_point(aes(size =4),show.legend = FALSE)+
    geom_line()
  return(list(imgs = approx_imgs, error_plot = error_plot))
}


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
res1 <- process_img_kaprrox(images$image1.csv, 1:9)
```
